# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi

    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.

        run: |

        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.

          fi

              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."

Rather than exhaustively covering everything, the primary lever is complexity reduction; coverage improvements are secondary. Let me now design the refactor concretely.

## Plan for smProvider.js

### Module-level extraction (keeping names identical so baseline matching keeps them as same functions):

Move out of `githubProvider` closure to module scope, parameterized by (owner, repo):

1. `branchHeadsMap(owner, repo)` — CC~9 (was 9). Keep name → baseline match (9 → must not go up; keep CC same).
2. `branchHead(owner, repo, name)` — CC~11.
3. `listOpenPrs(owner, repo)` / `listMergedPrs(owner, repo)` — CC~4-5 each.
4. `ghIssueToState(it)` — CC~5. Keep name.
5. `computePrStatus(owner, repo, prNumber, resolveBranchHead)` — split into:
  - `_githubFetchRollup(owner, repo, pr)` — fetch statusCheckRollup or commit check runs (CC~4).
  - `_githubDecideCheckConclusion(rollup)` — the forEach + realCount logic → returns {conclusion, ignored, bookept, realCount}? The decision has CC~8 (forEach + inner loop + conditions). Split further:
    - `_isBookeepingCheck(name)` CC2
    - `_classifyCheck(c)` → 'red'|'pending'|'ignore-canceled'|'ignore-bookeeping'|'neutral' CC~4
    - `_decideRollupConclusion(rollup)` → {red,pending} CC~3-4
  - `_githubDecideMergeState(pr, head)` — CC~6 (mergeable false / base.ref / head / BLOCKED / fallback).
  - `_githubBuildPrStatus(pr, rollup, ms)` — CC~3.
  Then `computePrStatus(owner, repo, prNumber, resolveBranchHead)` orchestrates: CC~4 (rollup empty fallback + branches). New name `computePrStatus` remains in file → baseline-matched (54 → drops). The new `_github*` helpers must each be ≤8 CRAP with tests.

Hmm wait — one subtlety: the rollup forEach mutates `red`, `pending` via closure. I'll rewrite as a reduce/classify loop — behavior identical.

Also important: `prStatus` memo method remains in the returned object calling `computePrStatus(owner, repo, prNumber, function(name){return branchHead(owner, repo, name);})`.

But careful: `computePrStatus` currently is a named function declaration inside githubProvider; tests reference behavior through prStatus. Fine.

### gitlabProvider (CC=48 → need ≤~28):

Extract module-level:
- `glIssueToState(it)` (CC~4) — new name (glIssueToState vs existing glIssueToState nested already). Baseline doesn't list glIssueToState above 8 (gitlabProvider covers it). Moving it out: new function CC~4 with tests → fine.
- `glComputePrStatus(mr, pipes)` split into `_glDecidePipelineConclusion(list)` (CC~4: forEach + canceled/failed/pending) and `_glDecideMergeState(mr)` (CC~4: 4 branches) + `_glBuildMrStatus(mr, concl, ms)` (CC~3). 
- `glFindPr(owner, repo, issueNumber, branchPrefix)` — CC~7: branch match + bodyRe... keep CC≤7 but CRAP≤8 requires CC≤8 at 100%... CC=7 at cov 82%: 49×0.0058+7=7.28 ✓. With tests cover both branches → ~100% → 7.0 ✓.
- `glListMachineIssues(owner, repo, machineLabels, agentHandle, limit)` — CC~6.
- `glCloseIssue(owner, repo, issueNumber, comment)` — CC~4 with console.warn + try/catch.
- `glActiveMachineRuns(owner, repo)` — CC~5.
- `glDispatchLeg`, `glUpdateBranch`, `glMerge`, `glAddIssueLabel` — one-liners, keep inline or extract (trivial CC2 each).

gitlabProvider closure then holds only `projectPath` and returns object → CC maybe ~5-10. 

### matchesGuards (CC=90 → need ≤~29 at 96% cov: CC=29 → 841×0.0006+29=29.05 ✓; CC=30 → 30.0 ✗ borderline; aim ≤25):

Group guards into module-level helpers (each new, must keep CRAP ≤8 → CC≤4-ish with coverage, CC≤5 at ≥51% cov):

1. `issueCarrierExcluded(q, labels, item)` → notLabels + hasOpenLinkedPr + blocked (CC~4: three early-return conditions).
2. `prObservationGuards(q, item)` → prChecks, prMergeState, mergeState, checks, notMergeState (CC~5 — five conditions; at 96% cov → 25×0.0006+5=5.0 ✓).
3. `mergeStateLatchMatches(q, item, repoInfo)` → the latch block (CC~5: !pr, latchWant, string normalize, for loop) — cover all branches in tests.
4. `reviewVerdictGuards(q, item, provider, machineAuthor)` → reviewStale + staleVerdict + latestVerdict/notLatestVerdict (CC~7: several conditions; at ~95% cov → 49×0.0001+7=7.0 ✓). Hmm CC=7 needs full coverage. Existing tests cover reviewStale/staleVerdict/verdict guards well. Make it CC≤6 by splitting verdict guards into `_latestVerdictGuard(q, item, provider, machineAuthor)` (CC~4) and `_reviewStaleGuards(q, item, provider)` (CC~3).
5. `threadsGuards(q, item, provider)` → CC~4.
6. `machineAuthorAndPrGuards(q, item, machineAuthor, owner, prLs)` → prMachineAuthor + mergeable + prState + blocked + prLabels + notPrLabels (CC~6).

Then matchesGuards becomes ~6 sequential if-calls: CC ~7-10. ✓

Behavior-identical ordering matters: the guards return false at specific points but they're independent → same result regardless, except side effects: provider.lastReview / latestVerdictRecord / reviewThreads are called lazily only when the corresponding q flag is set, and ordering of calls across different guards: reviewStale comes before staleVerdict, both call lastReview. In my grouping preserve order: reviewStale, staleVerdict first, then verdict records, then threads. I'll keep helpers in the exact same sequence.

### queryPrs (CC=67 → target ≤~25):

Extract:
1. `buildPrItems(prs)` — the map (CC~3).
2. `applyMutexFilter(q, items, log)` → returns filtered items or null when global defer (return [] case). CC: mutex branch + among + mutexMax + exclude-self loop + console.log → CC~8. Split: `mutexHolders(items, q.mutex, among)` (CC~3), and keep the filter inside queryPrs? Better: `applyMutexFilter(q, items)` handles: mutexMax compute, holders, both branches → CC~7; at 95.5% cov → 49×0.0009+7=7.0 ✓ but must cover all branches incl. console.log lines — existing tests cover mutex paths (they must, given 95.5%). Also the global-defer returns [] — signal via null return... but returning null vs [] distinction: keep `if (result === null) return [];`.
3. `prStatusNeeded(q)` (CC~3).
4. `fetchPrStatuses(items, provider, repoInfo, q)`? contains runAsync branch (CC~4).
5. `prCarrierGuardsMatch(item, rule, machineAuthor, owner)` → CC~8: blocked, labels, notLabels, draft, branchPrefix, notAuthors, notMachine, authors (8 conditions). CC=8 needs 100% coverage → 8.0 ✓ borderline. Split into two: `prCarrierLabelGuards(item, q2)` (blocked/labels/notLabels/draft → CC~5) and `prCarrierAuthorGuards(item, q2, machineAuthor, owner)` (branchPrefix/notAuthors/notMachine/authors → CC~5).
6. `sortPrCandidates(matched, limit, priorityLabels, repoInfo)` — the whole priority sort + premption log (CC~8: forEach + sort comparator + keptCount + forEach + some). Split: `assignPriorityTiers(matched, pl, repoInfo)` (CC~3: forEach with two calls), `priorityComparator(a,b)` (CC~2), `logPriorityPremption(matched, keptCount)` (CC~4). 
7. `enrichPrItemsWithStatus(items, provider, repoInfo, runAsyncAvailable)` — the needsStatus block (CC~4).

queryPrs then: build items, filter blocked, mutex (call), needsStatus? fetch, filter with guards, bench, sort, slice → CC ~10-12. At 95.5% cov: 144×0.0009+12 = 12.01 ✓ well under 30.

Also — `matchesGuards`'s wantList helper closure: hoist to module-level `wantList` function (CC~2, but name `wantList` new in githubSource — fine).

IMPORTANT global constraint: any other function's CRAP must not increase. E.g., `queryIssues` calls matchesGuards — unchanged. `query` unchanged.

Rough estimate from the report: findPr reported 9.4 CRAP at 58.3% cov → CC=8 (64×0.0746+8=12.8? no: u=0.417, u³=0.0725, 64×0.0725+8=12.6 ≠ 9.4). Hmm. CC=7: 49×0.0725+7=10.6. CC=6: 36×.0725+6=8.6. Hmm 9.4 → CC≈6.5? Formula might use u³ differently... maybe CRAP = CC²·u³ + CC where u = uncovered fraction... For findPr: 9.4 = CC²·u³+CC. Try CC=6, u=0.417: 36×0.0725+6=8.61. CC=7: 10.55. Neither is 9.4. Maybe coverage fraction is branch/statement mix. Whatever.

Key insight: to reduce githubProvider's CC, I must move the anonymous METHOD bodies out (extract to module-level named functions) or reduce their decision points. Moving a method body to a module-level named function `_ghFindPr(owner, repo, full, issueNumber, branchPrefix)` makes it a named declaration → excluded from githubProvider AND from the method wrapper `findPr: function (i, p) { return _ghFindPr(owner, repo, full, i, p); }` CC=1.

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi

          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

Then computePrStatus becomes an orchestrator: fetch pr, rollup, decide conclusion, decide merge state (needs branchHead closure), build. Each helper CC ≤ some small number and covered by tests.

**githubProvider (113.3)** — the big closure. Extract helpers to module level so the closure shrinks. # gh-1009: [CRAP] SM providers and sources: smProvider.githubProvider (113) + gitlabProvider (60) + computePrStatus (54) + githubSource.matchesGuards (90) + queryPrs (67)

## Description

## Problem
Factory SM plumbing: `js/common/smProvider.js::githubProvider` **113.3**, `gitlabProvider` **59.6**, `computePrStatus` **54**, and `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js::matchesGuards` **90.4**, `queryPrs` **67.4**. Dispatch decisions depend on these, so keep behaviour byte-identical.

## Goal
Bring each named function under CRAP 30 by extracting pure parse/build/decide helpers and covering every branch with characterization tests. Same tracker/SCM/git calls in the same order. Apply the one-small-tested-function-per-provider-method pattern already used for the SCM ADO provider.

## Acceptance
- Behaviour unchanged; each named function at or below the target; no regression; CI `crap` check green and the node harness stays green (canonical runner: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`).
- No code path removed; uncovered paths get a characterization test.

## Rules (read before starting)
- **Pure refactor, behaviour-preserving, backward compatible.** Same exports, same signatures, same return shapes, same log lines/side effects, same tracker/SCM calls in the same order. No config or API changes.
- **Tests first:** add characterization tests that pin the current behaviour of the paths you touch (the node harness: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`), then extract pure helpers (`parse*`/`build*`/`decide*`) from the big function and test those directly. Raising coverage on the function counts as much as splitting it.
- **CRAP gate:** Quality/`crap` compares this PR with the released baseline (`crap-baseline` release). The target function must go DOWN, no function may go up, new functions must be <= 8 (CRAP = CC² + CC at 0% coverage, so an untested helper needs CC <= 2 — or cover it). `crap:improved` is set automatically when it dropped. The baseline is updated by CI after the merge — do **not** commit a baseline file.
- Measure locally: `node ci/run_with_coverage.js …` then `crap4js . --coverage … --threshold 8 --baseline <released crap-baseline.json>` (see .github/workflows/quality.yml).
- Do not "fix" CRAP by deleting tests, adding `/* istanbul ignore */`, or excluding files.

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

          exit $code

        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:

        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"

# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the

name: Quality

on:

    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:

    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}

jobs:

          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure

    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)

          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}

        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi

          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"

            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber

            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

Then computePrStatus becomes an orchestrator: fetch pr, rollup, decide conclusion, decide merge state (needs branchHead closure), build. Each helper CC ≤ some small number and covered by tests.
